terrainWidth = 100.0   # size in Y direction

tire_step_size = step_size

vehicle.SetTrackShoeType(veh.TrackShoeType_SINGLE_PIN)

vehicle.SetTransmissionType(veh.TransmissionModelType_AUTOMATIC_SHAFTS)

vehicle.SetTrackShoeVisualizationType(vis_type)

vehicle.GetSystem().SetCollisionSystemType(chrono.ChCollisionSystem.Type_BULLET)

# Create the terrain
patch_mat = chrono.ChContactMaterialSMC()
patch_mat.SetFriction(0.9)
patch_mat.SetRestitution(0.01)
terrain = veh.RigidTerrain(vehicle.GetSystem())
patch = terrain.AddPatch(patch_mat, 
    chrono.ChCoordsysd(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0), chrono.QUNIT), 
    terrainLength, terrainWidth)

patch.SetTexture(veh.GetDataFile("terrain/textures/tile4.jpg"), 200, 200)
patch.SetColor(chrono.ChColor(0.8, 0.8, 0.5))

vis.AddSkyBox()

# Create the driver system
driver = veh.ChInteractiveDriverIRR(vis)

# Set the time response for steering and throttle keyboard inputs.

driver.SetBrakingDelta(render_step_size / braking_time)

# output vehicle mass

# Number of simulation steps between miscellaneous events

while vis.Run() :

        vis.BeginScene()

        vis.EndScene()

```python
import pychrono as chrono
import pychrono.vehicle as veh
import pychrono.irrlicht as irr
import pychrono.driver as driver

# Initialize the Chrono system
system = chrono.ChSystemNSC()
system.Set_G_acc(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, -9.81))

# Create the M113 vehicle
m113 = veh.M113()
m113.SetContactMethod(chrono.ChContactMethod_NSC)
m113.SetChassisFixed(False)
m113.SetInitPosition(chrono.ChCoordsysD(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 1.2), chrono.QUNIT))
m113.Initialize(system)

# Create the rigid terrain
terrain = veh.RigidTerrain(system)
patch_mat = chrono.ChMaterialSurfaceNSC()
patch_mat.SetFriction(0.8)
patch_mat.SetRestitution(0.2)
patch = terrain.AddPatch(patch_mat, chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 0), chrono.ChVectorD(200, 200, 1))
patch.SetTexture(chrono.GetChronoDataFile("terrain/textures/grass.jpg"))
terrain.Initialize()

# Create the Irrlicht application
application = irr.ChIrrApp(system, 'M113 Simulation', irr.dimension2du(1024, 768))
application.AddTypicalSky()
application.AddTypicalLights()
application.AddTypicalCamera(chrono.Vector(0, -5, 2), m113.GetChassisBody().GetPos())

# Create the driver system
driver = veh.ChIrrGuiDriver(application.GetDevice(), m113.GetVehicle(), "M113 Driver")
driver.SetSteeringDelta(0.05)
driver.SetThrottleDelta(0.2)
driver.SetBrakingDelta(0.2)
driver.Initialize()

# Set up the simulation loop
step_size = 0.01
time = 0
timer = chrono.ChRealtimeStepTimer()

while application.GetDevice().run():
    # Get driver inputs
    driver_inputs = driver.GetInputs()

    # Synchronize the vehicle, terrain, and driver
    m113.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs, terrain)
    terrain.Synchronize(time)
    driver.Synchronize(time)

    # Update visualization
    application.BeginScene()
    application.DrawAll()
    application.EndScene()

    # Advance the simulation
    system.DoStepDynamics(step_size)
    time += step_size

    # Maintain real-time
    timer.Spin(step_size)
```

```python
    time = vehicle.GetSystem().GetChTime()
    
    # Render scene
    if step_number % math.ceil(render_step_size / step_size) == 0:
        vis.BeginScene()
        vis.Render()
        vis.EndScene()
        render_frame += 1

    # Get and modify driver inputs
    driver_inputs = driver.GetInputs()
    driver_inputs.throttle = 0.8  # Hard-coded throttle value

    # Synchronize modules
    driver.Synchronize(time)
    terrain.Synchronize(time)
    vehicle.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs)
    vis.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs)

    # Advance simulation
    driver.Advance(step_size)
    terrain.Advance(step_size)
    vehicle.Advance(step_size)
    vis.Advance(step_size)
    
    step_number += 1
    realtime_timer.Spin(step_size)
```
